bead.title: Shared composed recovery wiring
bead.description:
PROBLEM
`ComposedBackend::recover` already expects a projection high-water plus tail replay, but the relational family currently feeds it a replayless, authoritative-store contract, so the shared recovery choke point cannot rebuild relational state from the log.
ROOT CAUSE
`crates/pqueue-engine/src/compose.rs:673-680, 1190-1274` defaults `recovery_high_water` to `None` and then replays from whatever the projection reports, while the relational backends still return replayless state.
PROPOSED FIX
Wire the composed recovery path to consume the relational family’s persisted applied-high-water, replay the durable log tail through `ComposedBackend::recover`, and preserve counter seeding plus definition hydration so exact acknowledged state survives reopen.
NON-SCOPE
backend-specific persistence details, conformance-label changes, docs wording cleanup, and the `pqueue-b59f4897` prerequisite implementation.
bead.acceptance:
1. `TestComposedRelationalRecoverReplaysTail` proves `ComposedBackend::recover` replays from the relational family’s applied high-water instead of genesis.
2. `TestComposedRelationalRecoverySeedsCounters` proves item-id counters still resume monotonically after reopen.
3. `cargo test -p pqueue-postgres --test composed_relational_reconnect` and `cargo test -p pqueue-sqlite --test composed_relational_reconnect` pass with the new recovery seam.
4. `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
